critical_flows: Verify page load: Ensure the main heading is displayed correctly.
Verify 'More Information' link navigates to the expected external resource.
Basic Accessibility: Check if heading structure is logical (H1 is present)
validations: Verify the text content of the main heading matches 'Example Domain'.
Verify the 'More Information' link's href attribute contains 'iana' and the page loads the IANA website.
Verify link is focusable and keyboard navigable.
test_focus: Basic page load and element rendering.
risks: Broken link: 'More Information' link may lead to a 404 or incorrect page.
Incorrect heading text: Mismatch between expected and actual heading text.
Third-party Dependency: Page relies on IANA website availability.
